Counsel for Applicant :- Raj Kumar Singh,Akhilesh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anish Kumar Sinha
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.
Affidavit filed on behalf of opposite party No. 2 today in Court, is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State, Anish Kumar Sinha, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 and perused the record.
3.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 1.3.2019 and cognizance order dated 8.4.2019 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 2597 of 2019 (State vs. Santosh Gaur and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 468 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Rudrapur, District- Deoria, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 11, Deoria.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party No. 2 is the wife of applicant No. 1 and sister in-law of applicant No. 2.

Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted that on account of matrimonial discord, the present criminal case was instituted against the applicants,

sentences.text: however, with the intervention of the respected members of both the family and society, they have amicably and genuinely settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against the each other.

5. Learned counsel for the applicants has next drawn the attention of the Court to a compromise application dated 13.4.2023 supported by an affidavit, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure No. 4 to this application.

6. Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between them, entire proceedings be quashed against the applicants.
7. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also appeared and has filed an affidavit and in paragraph-7, the said compromise has been acknowledged.
Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that the said compromise has taken place without any coercion, fear and undue influence.
Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted, on instructions, that opposite party No. 2 has no objection if the entire proceedings are quashed.
8. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of :-
1. B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
2. Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].
